entities.summary:
Yurii Shirokov, was a writer, physicist, and professor. He graduated from Moscow State University (Moscow) in 1948. He worked in the same university, then in the Steklov Mathematical Institute (Moscow). He wrote more than 100 scientific papers

and several monographs, among which the textbook Nuclear Physics is particularly relevant.
